name: swati-sharma-makeup
description: Website for Swati Sharma Makeup Artistry: React frontend + Express API

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run setup && npm run build --prefix client
